pciAliasHelp.ready: Read from controller nova-api configuration files. This does not prove that Nova reloaded them or that compute-node aliases match. Device classification and Placement usage are separate observations.
pciAliasHelp.partial: The configured alias snapshot is incomplete or inconsistent. New alias selections are blocked until a complete snapshot is available.
pciAliasHelp.unavailable: The configured alias snapshot is unavailable. Existing templates remain visible, but new alias selections cannot be verified.
pciInventoryHelp.partial: Some PCI inventory or allocation observations could not be verified. Shown records may be incomplete; unknown usage is not zero.
pciInventoryHelp.unavailable: PCI inventory and allocation observations are unavailable. This does not mean that no PCI devices exist.
pciUnknownRoleHelp: Selecting a primary or companion assigns that role explicitly. Verify the unclassified device identities below; no physical same-card guarantee is made.
pciConfirmUnknown: I verified these unclassified aliases and confirm their selected GPU or companion roles.
pciTitle: Nova PCI aliases and Placement observations
pciHelp: Configured aliases and observed resources are independent. An alias group requests devices together; it does not guarantee they belong to the same physical card.
pciLoadFailed: PCI observations could not be loaded. Refresh to retry; existing templates remain editable.
pciAliasesEmpty: No configured aliases in this snapshot.
pciInventoryEmpty: No PCI inventory reported by Placement.
pciInventoryUnknown: PCI inventory is not fully known.
pciCreationUnavailable: Creating a group requires a complete alias snapshot and a supported GPU alias. Existing templates remain editable.
pciCompanionHelp: Select exact companion aliases to request one of each per GPU. Unclassified aliases require separate role confirmation; unsupported aliases cannot be selected.
pciLegacyHelp: Existing template: edit advanced fields without replacing custom specs. Snapshot observations do not reapprove this template.
automationReadinessHelp: Afterglow checks its own creation paths only. Authorized direct Nova/API callers can bypass these limits; native scheduling and project quotas remain authoritative. This is not atomic domain-wide quota enforcement.
title: Domain shared compute pool
help: Actual CPU, RAM and GPU consumption is shared across the domain. Project ceilings are not reservations or allocations.
saved: Saved state confirmed by the server.
limitHelp: Whole number ≥ 0, or -1 for unlimited. Blank CPU/RAM adds no Afterglow limit; missing GPU resources deny access. Native project quotas still apply.
transitionHelp: Afterglow checks its own creation paths only. Authorized direct Nova/API callers can bypass these limits; native scheduling and project quotas remain authoritative. This is not atomic domain-wide quota enforcement.
capHelp: Applies only to the exact project in this domain. Ceilings need not sum to the pool limit and do not reserve capacity from other projects.
capLimitHelp: Pool limit: {limit}. Leave blank for no additional project ceiling on this resource.
invalidCap: Project ceilings must be whole numbers no greater than the pool limit.
conflict: The policy changed. Refresh and review your changes before submitting again.
reloadRequired: Refresh to inspect actual state before another action. No automatic retry is performed.
unknownOutcome: The write outcome could not be confirmed.
scopeMismatch: The response domain does not match the current target.
loadFailed: Could not load compute policy. Refresh to retry.
legacyHelp: Manage GPU consumption through domain shared pools. Native project quotas and defaults remain independently managed in every domain, regardless of pool state.
automationHelp: Stock Nova/Placement APIs reconcile supported shapes from retained, included hosts and approved GPU templates. Missing/down hosts do not retire shapes. GPU shapes reach all enabled projects in matching allocated domains. Verified existing and new manual CPU flavors are managed automatically; private flavor access for domain projects may change. Public flavors stay public in Nova, so direct requests can bypass Afterglow policy.
reconciled: Reconciliation response received. Inspect the actual changes and diagnostics below.
diagnostics: Status · Host inventory and GPU approval
managedReadonly: This flavor is automation-managed. Specs, access and visibility are reconciled automatically and cannot be changed or deleted manually here.
pauseHelp: Pausing blocks new allocations through Afterglow only. Direct Nova/API callers are not blocked by this policy. Existing VMs and native project quotas are unchanged.
domainQuotaTitle: Domain shared pool · remaining after optional project ceilings
domainGpuTitle: Shared domain GPU remaining (project ceilings included)
projectAncillary: Native project VM and storage quotas remain independent
domainInsufficient: Insufficient remaining domain pool or additional project ceiling.
staleCapHelp: Some project ceilings are not verified in the current domain directory. These UUIDs are not proven deleted, and usage is unavailable. An explicit removal request succeeds only after the server verifies exact project absence, complete directory absence and zero Placement usage.
scopeHelp: Afterglow checks its own creation paths only. Authorized direct Nova/API callers can bypass these limits; native scheduling and project quotas remain authoritative. This is not atomic domain-wide quota enforcement.
hostsHelp: Down, disabled or missing hosts retain their last supported inventory until explicitly removed. Retained inventory is not live schedulable capacity.
hostsEmpty: No verified hosts retained. Discover hosts to observe supported inventory.
removeHostConfirm: Remove {name} ({id}) from automation? Afterglow disables a present nova-compute service through stock Nova and confirms the result. No VM, host or flavor is deleted or migrated.
reincludeConfirm: Include {name} ({id}) again? This does not enable a native service disabled for maintenance. Review native service status separately.
profilesHelp: Only explicitly enabled, saved templates authorize GPU flavors. Builtin device names and newly discovered GPUs never approve a template. Matching allocated domains publish each shape to every enabled project; optional project ceilings do not change catalog access.
scaleHelp: Native PCI aliases attach each GPU and companion device. Alias counts scale together with GPU count; Placement resources alone do not attach devices. New standard names use gpu.4090x2_8c_16g; existing owned names are retained and collisions may add a suffix.
profilesEmpty: No GPU templates approved. CPU automation can operate without GPU templates.
slugHelp: Exact lowercase slug, e.g. 3060, 3060lhr or 4090. Variants are separate approvals.
resourceHelp: Positive integer counts; the primary GPU resource count must be 1. Include explicit companion resources.
aliasHelp: Map each exact scheduling alias to its resource class. Multiple aliases or companion resources require explicit mapping; names and order are never inferred.
invalidProfile: Check unique lowercase names, primary count 1, positive resource counts, string specs and exact alias mappings. Afterglow ownership specs are prohibited.
unsavedProfiles: Unsaved templates: save or refresh before discovering or changing a host.
